faqs.question: Does this include the screws?
faqs.answer: Yes — the casing ships with the matching screw set. Rubber feet are pre-fitted.

faqs.question: Will I need a technician to fit it?
faqs.answer: Fitting means transferring internals from your old bottom cover, so we recommend a technician unless you're comfortable opening a laptop. We can refer one on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with a casing?
faqs.answer: This casing carries a 3-month warranty against manufacturing defects such as cracking or misaligned mounting points.
